title: A Light Saber
subtitle: Prop Building With Home Depot Parts
blurb: Prop-ready lightsaber built from slip-joint drain pipe, electronics and a rotary tool. Made to look like obi-wans saber from the prequil trillogy
details: One lightsaber only: a short slim hilt held upright, with one long straight blade of light, rising from the emitter well past the top edge of the frame. The blade is a bright, solid off-white core with a light-orange glow, and must read clearly as a glowing laser sword, not a flat beam or stripe. Hilt is a plain grey drain-pipe tube with three or four ribbed grip rings, a slip nut, a small emitter shroud and a round pommel. No crossed parts, no second blade, no tools, no sparks. Flat solid orange background, bold black outlines, orange rim glow on the hilt, spray drips. No text or marks anywhere.

title: Prop Muskets
subtitle: For Les Miserables
blurb: Stained wood prop muskets based on the brown bess, from 2x6 stock and electrical conduit, under $4 each.
details: One musket only, centered, in a low three-quarter view. Full-bleed flat orange background with no border. Stock is a chunky, boxy slab of 2x6 with visible grain. Barrel is a plain electrical conduit tube with simple band clamps, no strap, no pencil, no wood shavings. Bold black stencil outlines, spray overspray and a few drips. No marks, scribbles or signatures anywhere in the image.

title: Journey to 180
subtitle: A Personal Weight Loss Dashboard
blurb: A personal progress tracker for losing weight from 400 lb down to a goal of 180 lb, with a timeline projected at 1.5 and 2 lb per week. All data stays on the device.
details: Top-down view looking straight down onto a bathroom scale, the same framing as the original photo. A rounded-square grey-blue scale platform fills the frame, with a pair of bare feet standing on it, wearing yellow flip-flops, and jeans cuffs at the top edge. A round white dial sits between the feet with a black centre, a single needle and plain tick marks, no numerals. Feet are chunky stencil shapes with heavy black outlines, the scale is a flat grey-blue block, and the wood floor is replaced by a flat orange field. Orange glow on the edges, spray overspray and drips. No faces, no text, no numbers anywhere.

title: Strength, Cardio & Miles
subtitle: Gym Training Split
blurb: A weekly gym split: strength-focused CrossFit three days a week, treadmill intervals and rowing on two more, and two bike rides of 12+ miles.

title: The Cronin Group
subtitle: Software Consulting for Modern Teams
blurb: Software consulting for modern teams, from enterprise cloud architecture to AI-assisted development support, delivering production-grade systems.
details: The company's logo is a monogram of three chunky 3D letter shapes, T, C and G, with the T in charcoal grey and the C and G in cream and tan, all with black edges and drop shadows, set over an orange and grey brush-stroke field with white streaks. Make one large chunky monogram of three letter-shaped forms in charcoal, cream and tan, a slightly low three-quarter view, with stencil-cut edges and black outlines. Brush strokes of orange, white and grey streak across a flat orange field. Small cloud and server cues are allowed. No readable letters, no words, no company name spelled out, no signature.

title: Double Watt Games
subtitle: Designing Games for Gamers
blurb: A board game design studio whose games work through mechanics and theme together, with the player's decisions at the centre. Built around a light bulb mark.
details: The studio's logo is a light bulb with a bold black outline, a light grey or cream inside, a black script letter w as the filament glow, two thin filament lines, and a ridged black screw base. Show one large light bulb, centered and seen from a slightly low three-quarter angle, with the same script w and filament lines as the logo. Use off-white or light grey for the glass and the orange for the glow. Flat solid orange background, bold black stencil outlines, orange rim glow, spray drips. No other objects, no text or lettering other than the w mark.

title: Sanctuary Pew Planner
subtitle: Wheelchair Seating Layouts
blurb: A single-page tool for rearranging a church's existing pews to make room for wheelchair seating, with live seat counts and PDF export.
details: Two people worshiping side by side in ONE row of a single long wooden church pew, seen from behind in a low three-quarter angle, no faces. The person on the left sits on the pew with head bowed and hands folded. The second person sits in a wheelchair directly next to them, in a gap at the end of that same pew, shoulder to shoulder, both facing the same direction. They are one pair, one subject, filling the center of the frame. Chunky flat stencil silhouettes in charcoal and mid grey with off-white highlights, pew in mid grey with a charcoal end panel, wheelchair near-black with off-white rims. The whole background AND the floor are one flat bright orange #FF6A00 field, no cream or white floor, no walls, no windows, no second pew. Bold black stencil outlines, orange rim glow, heavy spray overspray, grainy grunge texture, a few spray drips. All four corners are clean and empty: no marks, signatures, symbols, scribbles, text or lettering anywhere.
